mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost range for exterior stucco coating application?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of exterior stucco coating application varies widely depending on several factors. These include the total square footage of the area to be coated, the condition of the existing stucco requiring repair or preparation, the type of coating selected (acrylic vs. elastomeric), and accessibility challenges. While we can't provide an exact figure without an on-site evaluation, generally, homeowners can expect a cost per square foot that reflects the material quality, labor, and the specialized application process involved. We provide detailed, no-obligation estimates after a thorough property assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: The cost for exterior stucco coating varies by square footage, existing stucco condition, coating type, and accessibility. We provide custom estimates after a property assessment.
